title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Langflow, MongoDB, and More
summary: This release adds multiple new modules, and 6 of those modules point at a single target: Langflow, the open-source LLM workflow builder. Together they cover an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-93680), 3 unauthenticated remote code execution paths (CVE-2026-0768, CVE-2026-0769, and CVE-2026-10134), and 2 authenticated code execution flaws (CVE-2026-7873 and CVE-2026-93674), spanning Langflow releases from 1.0.0 through 1.11.4.
body_markdown:
This release adds multiple new modules, and 6 of those modules point at a single target:[Langflow](https://www.langflow.org/) , the open-source LLM workflow builder. Together they cover an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-93680), 3 unauthenticated remote code execution paths (CVE-2026-0768, CVE-2026-0769, and CVE-2026-10134), and 2 authenticated code execution flaws (CVE-2026-7873 and CVE-2026-93674), spanning Langflow releases from 1.0.0 through 1.11.4. Thanks to the work of[rmhowe425](https://github.com/rmhowe425) , with research credit to Peter Girnus and n0k0. Beyond Langflow, open source contributor[kmkz](https://github.com/kmkz) contributed a pre-auth RCE chain against OpenCTI. MongoDB coverage has also been expanded with 3 new auxiliary modules plus an Apache Solr version scanner thanks to the work of community member[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) .


## New Module Content (11)


### 4gaBoards Mass User Information Disclosure (CVE-2026-53959)


Authors: Balachandar Gowrisankar, de3erve (GitHub), and lucquach (GitHub)


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21831](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21831) contributed by[anirbala98](https://github.com/anirbala98)


Path: gather/4gaboards_users_info_disclosure_cve_2026_53959


CVE reference:[CVE-2026-53959](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-53959/)


Description: Adds a module that exploits CVE-2026-53959, a broken access control vulnerability allowing mass user information disclosure in 4gaBoards versions 3.3.8 and below. The application's /api/users REST endpoint lets any authenticated user retrieve a full, unpaginated list of every user in the system. Missing authorization checks allow an attacker to retrieve the email, phone, organization, name, and SSO email addresses (ssoGoogleEmail, ssoGithubEmail, and others) of every user.

Author: Richard Howe


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21942](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21942) contributed by[rmhowe425](https://github.com/rmhowe425)

CVE reference:[CVE-2026-93680](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-93680/)


Description: Adds a new auxiliary module that leverages CVE-2026-93680, an authentication bypass vulnerability impacting Langflow versions 1.5.0 through 1.11.4.


### Apache Solr Version Scanner


Author: h00die

Pull request:[#22006](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/22006) contributed by[h00die](https://github.com/h00die)

Description: Adds a new scanner that identifies Apache Solr and reports its version.


### MongoDB Auxiliary Module Suite


Authors: h00die and prithvee07


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21785](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21785) contributed by[h00die](https://github.com/h00die)


Description: Adds the mongodb_version, mongodb_schemadump, and mongodb_hashdump auxiliary modules, and updates the existing mongodb_login module.


This PR adds the following modules:


- scanner/mongodb/mongodb_hashdump
- scanner/mongodb/mongodb_schemadump
- scanner/mongodb/mongodb_version

## Enhancements and Features (3)


- [#20944](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/20944) from[Nayeraneru](https://github.com/Nayeraneru) - Adds specs to ensure the mkdir post API behaves consistently.
- [#21915](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21915) from[vjonline](https://github.com/vjonline) - Consolidates reverse handler bind address handling into a shared Msf::Handler::Reverse::Bind module.
- [#22041](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/22041) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Adds multiple Meterpreter improvements. The Windows Meterpreter has a major reflective-loader/IAT-import reduction, as well as improved WinAPI/error handling, and MinGW/CMake build refinements. The Python Meterpreter has improvements to Windows stat support and FreeBSD process listing. The PHP Meterpreter resolves PHP UDP channel read bugs. All Meterpreters now align on recursive mkdir -p capabilities.


## Bugs Fixed (6)


- [#21490](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21490) from[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) - Fixes a crash when fingerprinting HTTP services that contained null bytes.
- [#21979](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21979) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Adds additional HTTP redirect checks to multiple modules.
- [#21994](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21994) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Adds additional FTP PASV IP validation checks to multiple modules.
- [#22001](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/22001) from[Suryanshuv14](https://github.com/Suryanshuv14) - Fixes DirtyClone module metadata and a typo.
- [#22002](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/22002) from[mjatin2007](https://github.com/mjatin2007) - Fixes leaking TCP sockets and file descriptors when the MSSQL Login Scanner module or the MSSQL session type is used.
- [#22014](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/22014) from[cgranleese-r7](https://github.com/cgranleese-r7) - Fixes false positives in the detection logic of the auxiliary/gather/hikvision_info_disclosure_cve_2017_7921, auxiliary/gather/magento_xxe_cve_2024_34102, and auxiliary/scanner/http/elasticsearch_traversal modules.

## Get it


As always, you can update to the latest Metasploit Framework with msfupdate and you can get more details on the changes since the last blog post from GitHub:


- [Pull Requests 6.5.6…6.5.8](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pulls?q=is:pr+merged:)
- [Full diff 6.5.6…6.5.8](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/compare/6.5.6%E2%80%A66.5.8)


If you are a git user, you can clone the[Metasploit Framework repo](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework) (master branch) for the latest. To install fresh without using git, you can use the open-source-only[Nightly Installers](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/wiki/Nightly-Installers) or the commercial edition[Metasploit Pro](https://www.rapid7.com/products/metasploit/download/)
